verdict.rationale: Phaser scenes are authored as plain JavaScript/TypeScript classes (not binary scene files), and the docs confirm JS/TS-based development with npm packaging and full TypeScript definitions, which implies naturally diffable, git-friendly source files. However, there is no explicit documentation addressing multi-person collaboration workflows, merge conflict handling for scenes/assets, or how the visual Scene Editor's project files behave under version control. Missing for 10: explicit VCS/collaboration guidance, evidence on Scene Editor file diffability/mergeability, and any built-in multi-user collaboration features.
